title: Deterministic restricted-weight cost
statement: Given a restricted-weight input and a finite set $S$, define the deterministic learning cost as the componentwise sum of a cost with zero random-example calls and zero membership queries whose work is the construction work, the deterministic query-batch cost for the input, and a cost with zero random-example calls and zero membership queries whose work is the local work for $S$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define construction work, deterministic query count, query-batch cost, or local work, so their precise meanings cannot be stated.
